analysis.pricePattern: Higher Low 형성 후 회복 신호
analysis.pricePatternEn: Higher Low formation followed by recovery signal
analysis.reason: RSI 45.3에서 58.9로 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램 역시 15.5814에서 565.3435로 가파르게 개선되며 상승 모멘텀 강화. 5일 연속 양봉 마감 및 최근 3거래일 강한 상승세(+1.97%, +2.18%, +2.85%)로 추세 강화 국면 진입.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 45.3 to 58.9, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram also sharply improved from 15.5814 to 565.3435, strengthening upward momentum. Confirmed by 5 consecutive days of positive closes and strong upward momentum in the last 3 trading days (+1.97%, +2.18%, +2.85%), indicating entry into an strengthening trend phase.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 114,155) vs SMA5 (KRW 109,756) / SMA20 (KRW 108,479) / SMA50 (KRW 106,122): Confirmed short-to-mid-term uptrend.
· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 116,372) / SMA200 (KRW 95,998): Mixed long-term trend, short-term bullish bias.
· 52-week position (63.7%) + Current price level at historical mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (45.3→58.9): Confirmed exit from oversold and entry into neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (15.5814→565.3435): Steep improvement, signaling bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (approaching upper band KRW 114,310): Approaching upper band phase.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 110,565): Support based on SMA20, EMA20.
· Swing resistance (KRW 114,535): Expectation of further upside upon breaking previous high.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): Strengthening recovery trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Strengthening uptrend): Considering buy entry based on RSI and MACD indicators.
